ArylF,aryl ether andexisting alcohols introduce no obligatory change of connectivity under carbonate/Pd conditions; retaining them is a compatibility inference, not proof of measured alcohol tolerance for this substrate. The source already demonstrates a substituted fused aryl bromide andbasic heteroaryl boronic partner rather than an unsubstituted phenyl-only coupling.
